ports.setup_and_data_boundary: Windows setup is a same-process dialog. PAL_LoadConfig sets SavePath=./ before the dialog changes only GamePath; first-session saves can therefore stay at the runtime cwd. PAL_SaveConfig omits SavePath=./; the next launch may instead default saves to the selected external GamePath. The guide keeps both coordinates at the same working copy. A separate runtime folder needs an explicit absolute SavePath before the first session. DOS/Windows edition/save formats remain distinct.
ports.managed_fit: Managed proposal rejected before source adoption after two independent reviewers found first-session save writes outside the cfg-only contract and later path switching. This is an actual source defect/boundary, not optional gameplay uncertainty or universal Unsupported status.
ports.next_action: Establish a stable first-session/restart save coordinate through upstream repair or supported preparation and preserve all real writers before managed admission. No new product deferral or artificial marker.
